title: New Era — Job Aggregator
description: Personal job tracking tool that aggregates listings from LinkedIn and Jobindex.dk, scores them with a local LLM against your CV and preferences, and manages the application pipeline on a kanban board — all running locally, no cloud.
highlights: Aggregates and deduplicates listings from LinkedIn and Jobindex.dk by source + external ID
Local Ollama model (gemma4:26b) scores each job 0–100 against your CV with inline reasoning
Async analysis pipeline — jobs appear immediately, scores fill in as the LLM completes
Four-column kanban (Applied → Interview → Offer → Rejected) with notes and interview dates

images.caption: Jobs feed — ranked by match score
